issues.root_cause: Minor layout shift observed during hydration of some Client components.
issues.fix: Ensure loading skeletons exactly match the dimensions of the lazy-loaded Client components.

issues.root_cause: Framer Motion layout animations add ~30KB to initial load.
issues.fix: Use the LazyMotion component and domAnimation feature to load Framer Motion features asynchronously.

optimization_recommendations: 1. Implement Framer Motion `LazyMotion` for all animations to reduce initial main chunk size by ~30KB.
2. Ensure all dynamic component wrappers provide precise skeleton dimensions to eliminate residual CLS during chunk loading.
3. Consider further lazy-loading lucide-react icons if they contribute significantly to the chunks, utilizing Next.js optimizePackageImports.
4. Add an intersection observer to delay mounting heavy tool client wrappers until they enter the viewport, though current Suspense usage is acceptable.
verification_checklist: Run Lighthouse on all target pages and confirm scores ≥ targets.
Profile with Performance panel — no long tasks >50ms.
Take heap snapshots — memory returns to baseline.
Test on real low‑end Android device or BrowserStack.
